query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `userCompanies` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `userId` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `companyId` int NOT NULL,
  `branchId` int,
  `role` enum('admin','operacional','consultor') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'operacional',
  `isDefault` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `createdAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX `uc_user_idx` (`userId`),
  INDEX `uc_company_idx` (`companyId`),
  UNIQUE INDEX `uc_user_company_idx` (`userId`, `companyId`, `branchId`)
);
